To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) 3-D convolution networks can be used for video description, and (ii) temporal attention is a useful mechanism to incorporate the temporal structure of videos in a video description task.

3-D CNN representations are effective in modeling the short term temporal dynamics of videos, that the proposed temporal attention mechanism is effective in modeling the global temporal structure, and that the two together lead to state-of-art results for video description.

(1) a spatial temporal 2-D CNN + 3-D CNN model can produce a good video representation; (2) a temporal attention mechanism can help to focus on the most relevant parts of a video; (3) our model can be trained on a small dataset of paired videos and natural language description and can be used to generate video description.
